neighbours.label: A modifier or unit that frames a reported quantity or statistic (in cash, $N in assets, reported, perceived, confidence interval)
fire: By March the startup held almost $40 million in cash, the filing said.
The lender, with $12 billion in deposits, opened two branches.
The service, with a reported 50 million subscribers, raised its fees.
Among 210 patients, 88 improved (42%, 95% confidence interval 35% to 49%).
Workers with the highest perceived level of fatigue were on night shifts.
The county with the lowest reported rate of smoking was in Utah.
Annual fraud losses rose to $600 million in total last year.
The fund holds a total asset base of at least USD 20 billion.
quiet: By March the startup had moved into a bright loft, the founder said.
The lender opened two branches beside the old bus station.
The service sends a short email when a parcel arrives.
Among the patients, several enjoyed the garden behind the ward.
Workers on night shifts eat together in the canteen upstairs.
The county fair in Utah has a rodeo and a pie contest.
The fraud case went to trial in a small courtroom last year.
The fund is run from a quiet office near the harbour.

notes: The + pole sits on summary statistics (Max, range, mean age was), so both sides concern reported numbers. Same topics without a quantity stayed quiet in probing.
